registration: Integer alignment in each burst and across windows; common valid overlap only, no interpolated beauty. Reject high aligned rigid-control residual/cuts rather than integer displacement alone. Report all shifts and rejected frames.
decision: Report hair residual, sparkle, gradient/detail and rigid-control metrics for every window and both domains. Derive bands from same-state repeats, require improvement in both late windows. No automatic quality pass from lower variance or reduced brightness.
appearance: Whole-frame PQ RGB histograms and mean, highlight percentiles and clipping compare both state repeats in rendered and presented bursts. These describe appearance, not linear energy. Inspect matching output-stage float full-frame means in dumps.json; normalize against pre-post compose 5c3fdabc. Never compare ungraded Xr/Z directly against rr_post=0 graded output. Check native grade/LUT identity, DoF silhouettes and bloom/highlight spread in trace previews. UI-contaminated PQ metrics are supplementary.
energy: Same-stage pre-post scene float means from dumps.json must match within repeat spread with zero nonfinite pixels. Lower brightness cannot qualify reduced flicker.
cost: Separate capture-free timing windows: report ngx guides/evaluate and rrpost chain/grade GPU ms. Ignore first straddling sample; no builds or diagnostics during future live cost windows.
